newsitem.title: SENEGAL: BASKETBALL-MOROCCAN TO HEAD AFRICAN BASKETBALL FEDERATION.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-MOROCCAN TO HEAD AFRICAN BASKETBALL FEDERATION.

text.p: Moroccan Yousri Hammouda was elected secretary general of the African Basketball Federation for a four-year term on Thursday.
Hammouda, chairman of the Moroccan Basketball Federation, received 11 votes against nine for Egyptian Mahmoud Ahmed Aly at the end of the 12th congress of the governing body for African basketball.
Senegalese Abdoulaye Seye won a second four-year term as president of the federation.
Twelve national teams will take part in the 19th African Basketball championship starting on Friday in the Senegalese capital.
